limitations: Only full-dimensional Euclidean right-corner tetrahedra with three orthogonal arms
Arm ratio is longest/shortest among those three arms, not all edges
Minimum of the normalized sum of all four vertex solid angles, not the minimum individual angle
Large-ratio asymptotic only; no uniform statement for arbitrary tetrahedra
scientific_integrity: The theorem is a same-model mathematical argument; its derivative and asymptotic expansions are explicit and numerical checks only corroborate the proof. No independent audit or historical priority certification is asserted.
title: A unique angular-sum optimizer for rectangular tetrahedra with a cube-root balancing law
